summary: Frontend-only verification of VA Training page wiring + VA portal regression. Logged in as approved VA (va.demo@hcobcleaners.com), confirmed Training tab appears in sidebar at correct index (Templates→Training→Messages), Training route /va/training renders VATraining.jsx with all 7 required section testids (section-required-fields, section-brand-rules, section-do, section-donot, section-tiers, section-checklist, section-outlets), 3 quick links navigate to /va/templates, /va/submit, /va/leaderboard. VA Submit Lead shows 5-required-fields banner + Month 1 callout; dropdowns include Deep clean, Move-out, Specialty, Commercial, Routine + sources LinkedIn/Craigslist/Nextdoor/Reddit/Yelp/Thumbtack/Angi/HomeAdvisor/Google Business/Cold Email/Facebook. All 6 other VA pages load without 404. Mobile drawer (390x844) shows va-mobile-nav-training and navigates to /va/training. No console errors aside from one expected 401 from an unauth poll prior to login.
critical_code_review_comments: VATraining.jsx is 433 lines of hard-coded content — fine for MVP but plan to move OUTLETS + sections array to a JSON/MDX source so non-devs can edit without redeploying.

Spec mentioned 'Recurring' as a service type but actual enum exposes it indirectly via 'Maintenance bundle (multi-service)' (commission engine treats repeat visits as recurring). Not a bug, but consider adding an explicit 'Recurring service plan' label if PMs expect it verbatim.

Training playbook content (5-field rule, Month 1 brand rules, commission tiers) is duplicated between VATraining.jsx and VASubmitLead banner — consider extracting shared copy/constants to avoid drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VA Training page is fully wired (App.js line 178, VALayout.jsx tabs index 6). All section-* testids verified. Submit Lead dropdowns are loaded via /api/va/options (working). No lead submission was performed (per request to avoid commission/dup writes).
